item.title: Request for Rear Glare Shield – Lamp Post on Western Way (A206) behind 70 Kentlea Road, SE28 0JZ, 20th November
item.description:
The street light column situated on the verge of Western Way (A206) directly behind the rear garden boundary of 70 Kentlea Road, SE28 0JZ is causing severe light intrusion onto my property. As shown in the attached night-time photos taken from inside my property, the unshielded light shines directly over my rear fence, flooding the entire garden and shining straight into my rear windows. Please could an engineer inspect this column on Western Way and fit a rear/house-side glare shield (baffle) to block the light spill onto 70 Kentlea Road? Kind regards, Syed 70 Kentlea Road, SE28 0JZ

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Kentlea Road, Thamesmead
